$description: One text family and four type styles. Figma names them desktop/navigation, desktop/label, desktop/body-small and desktop/body-large; the names here follow the Figma variable names inside those styles.

text.description: Figma navigation/font-family and label/font-family and body-small/font-family. Everything except the logotype.

regular.description: Figma body-small/font-weight. Body and field text.

light.description: Figma display-1/font-weight. The statistic number, and the only place the system goes lighter than regular.

medium.description: Figma body-large/font-weight. The amount in a donation field.

semibold.description: Figma navigation/font-weight and label/font-weight. Control labels and tags.

bold.description: Figma h4/font-weight. Headings and tab labels.

label.description: Figma label/font-size. Tags and field units. Always uppercase.

body-small.description: Figma body-small/font-size. Field labels, field text, small links.

body-large.description: Figma body-large/font-size. A value the reader typed and has to read back.

h4.description: Figma h4/font-size. The smallest heading, and the label on a tab.

h2.description: Figma desktop/h2 on the type sheet 9269:12262. A section heading under a carousel heading.

h3.description: Figma h3/font-size. The heading inside an open accordion.

h3-mobile.description: Figma mobile/h3. The same heading below the mobile breakpoint.

h4-mobile.description: Figma mobile/h4. The same small heading below the mobile breakpoint.

card-label.description: Figma 9918:27. The bold label above a base card's headline, a raw text node rather than a bound type style.

card-label-mobile.description: Figma 9918:29. The bold label above a base card's headline below the mobile breakpoint.

label-mobile.description: Figma mobile/label. The byline on an editorial card below the mobile breakpoint.

display-1.description: Figma display-1/font-size. The number on a statistic card. Nothing else in the library is this size.

display-1-mobile.description: Figma mobile/display-1 on the type sheet 9269:12262. The same number below the mobile breakpoint.

h1.description: Figma desktop/h1. A carousel section heading at desktop width.

h1-mobile.description: Figma mobile/h1. A carousel section heading below the mobile breakpoint.

h2-mobile.description: Figma mobile/h2 on the type sheet 9269:12262. The same section heading below the mobile breakpoint.

body-mobile.description: Figma mobile/body. Body copy below the mobile breakpoint.

body-large-mobile.description: Figma mobile/body-large. The lede on an index card description below the mobile breakpoint.

label.description: Figma desktop/label. Tight, because a label is one line.

body.description: Figma desktop/body-small and desktop/body-large. Holds for scripts with tall ascenders.

display.description: Figma desktop/display-1. Under one, because a single line of 112px needs the lines that follow it to close up.

h1.description: Figma desktop/h1 on the type sheet 9269:12262, 110 percent. 71.5px at 65px.

prose.description: The paragraph inside an open accordion. Drawn as a raw value on the layer, not as a Figma text style.

banner-title.description: Figma 7714:3343. The headline inside a notification banner, set looser than a heading because it wraps inside a narrow column.

label.description: Figma desktop/label, 5 percent. 0.55px at 11px. Uppercase needs the air.

display.description: Figma desktop/display-1, minus 3 percent. Minus 3.36px at 112px. Large text closes up.

display-mobile.description: Figma mobile/h1, minus 1.5 percent. Minus 0.57px at 38px.

h1.description: Figma desktop/h1, minus 2 percent. Minus 1.3px at 65px.

h2.description: Figma desktop/h2 on the type sheet 9269:12262, minus 1 percent. Minus 0.42px at 42px.

h2-mobile.description: Figma mobile/h2 on the type sheet 9269:12262, minus 0.5 percent. Minus 0.14px at 28px.

control-tight.description: Figma. The title of a story in a mega menu, which tracks in rather than out.

none.description: Figma desktop/body-large. Large text does not need tracking.
